column1: # clues.tsv for ft_str_is_printable — hints only, never answers.
Which byte values are "printable", and why does an empty string return 1? Recall the contiguous band of printable ASCII.

Control characters are not printable -- and newline and tab are control characters. Note exactly where the band starts and ends (just below space, just above '~'); bytes above 127 sit past the band too.
